_doc.what: Single source of truth for Orbit's patch MODULES. Each module is one cohesive feature of the patcher, declared as data: what it does, which tier it lives in, whether a user can toggle it, what it depends on, and the verification tokens that prove it applied. This catalog is what contributors edit to add/fix a patch and what the patch engine reads to apply a chosen SUBSET.
_doc.why: The patcher (Claude Code/patch_claude_vsix_v147.py) is a capture-based transform: it parses Claude Code's minified webview once to grab obfuscated identifiers, then many blocks share those captures and a fixed apply order. So patches are NOT all independent. This catalog makes the real dependency graph explicit so a user/contributor can pick a subset and the engine can resolve what that subset actually requires.
_doc.not_to_confuse_with: patchers/  (the ROLLBACK archive of whole historical patcher versions). This folder (patch_modules/) is the FORWARD module registry.

tiers.core: Always applied. Non-toggleable scaffold every feature depends on. Removing one breaks the patch.
tiers.sidebar: The right-hand session panel cluster. Interwoven; the panel itself is the cluster root, the rest depend on it. Toggles as a group today; pieces split out as couplings are untangled.
tiers.system: Features that also patch the extension host (extension.js) or RPC. Independent but cross-file.

fields.required: true = always applied, cannot be disabled (the resolver force-includes these).
fields.userFacing: true = surfaced as a user-visible on/off toggle in the UI.
fields.dependsOn: non-required module ids this module also needs (core/required deps are implicit).
fields.blocks: the patcher's internal block numbers this module owns (traceability into patch_webview_js).
fields.verify: verification-check names in verify_extension_dir() that prove this module applied. These are the contract: a module is 'broken' when its verify tokens go missing against a new Claude Code release.
fields.status: ok | watch | broken — maintained as Claude Code releases move anchors.

modules.title: Component captures
modules.summary: Parses the minified webview once to capture obfuscated identifiers (Rs/OR0/NR0/fe1 components, _R0/wR0/S0/w2/h6). Every sidebar block reuses these. No tokens of its own; proven transitively.

modules.title: Helper bootstrap
modules.summary: Injects CLAUDE_HELPER_JS (all ccPatch* helpers) plus the build-version marker at the captured anchor. The dependency root of the entire patch.

modules.title: CSS scaffold
modules.summary: Root/header wrapper classes and structural CSS every visual feature positions against.

modules.title: Right session sidebar
modules.summary: Splices a collapsible right sidebar mirroring the current workspace's chats, reusing the native Re1 recent-sessions props. CLUSTER ROOT: the other sidebar-* modules depend on this.

modules.title: Pin / star / archive sort
modules.summary: Re-sorts the session list so pinned/starred float and archived sink.

modules.title: List sections
modules.summary: Groups the list into Pinned / Starred / Sessions / Archived section headers.

modules.title: Session row redesign
modules.summary: Stacked name/time row with status dot and hover actions (pin, star, archive).

modules.title: Status indicators
modules.summary: Running / waiting / error status dots driven off the session state hook.

modules.title: Right-click menu
modules.summary: Row right-click menu (rename, pin, star, archive, color) + double-click-to-rename.

modules.title: Relative time
modules.summary: Rewrites the timestamp formatter (now / days ago).

modules.title: Collapse button
modules.summary: Collapse/expand button for the sidebar pane.

modules.title: Filter menu
modules.summary: Filter dropdown (all / pinned / starred / archived) with checkmarks.

modules.title: Search box
modules.summary: In-sidebar search toggle; hides Claude's built-in search row.

modules.title: New-session button
modules.summary: Replaces the native top-toolbar new-session button with the sidebar header one.

modules.title: Hide empty untitled
modules.summary: Hides empty Untitled sessions from the list.

modules.title: Send / steer / queue
modules.summary: Splits the composer send button into a steer/queue/stop control routed through Claude's own submit callback.

modules.title: Queued-message bubbles
modules.summary: Inline Codex-style queued-message bubbles in the transcript.

modules.title: Account usage rings
modules.summary: 5hr/weekly usage rings in the composer footer, read off the native utilization signal.

modules.title: Fork action row
modules.summary: Inline fork row in the message hover actions (fork is left on Claude's native handler).

modules.title: Rewind gate fix
modules.summary: Removes the file-changes precondition that disabled the native Rewind button.

modules.title: Show-more always on
modules.summary: Keeps long-message expand controls visible without the truncation gradient.

modules.title: Chat restyle
modules.summary: Re-orders user attachments/pills and timeline message styling.

modules.title: Image hover preview
modules.summary: Hover an image attachment to see a larger preview.

modules.title: Color themes
modules.summary: Theme picker modal with named color themes.

modules.title: Per-chat color
modules.summary: Assign an accent color to an individual chat.

modules.title: Sticky preview header
modules.summary: Toggle a sticky/floating chat-preview header.

modules.title: Switch-model item
modules.summary: Adds a switch-model item that runs the native `model` command.

modules.title: Settings dropdown
modules.summary: Orbit settings dropdown that hosts account-switch and instructions.

modules.title: Account switcher
modules.summary: Switch Claude accounts via a confirm modal + an extension-host RPC (patches extension.js too).

modules.title: CLAUDE.md editor
modules.summary: Read/write CLAUDE.md from a modal via extension-host RPC (patches extension.js too).
